description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Localization' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Localization SETTINGS — which locales the title offers, which one is the default (and therefore the fallback), what to render for a missing key, and the store limits. The translation TABLES are deliberately NOT here: they live in the separate TitleLocalization collection (one document per title+locale) and are delivered one file per locale, because text changes far more often than balance and must not invalidate the whole title config. Client resolution is t(x) = own table -> fallback table -> x itself, which is why a title whose DisplayName fields hold literal names keeps working unchanged: a literal is simply a key with no translation. Add or edit translations through the Localization endpoints, not through this section.

LocalizationLocaleDefinition.description: A single entry of the available-languages list. It exists so the game can draw the language picker BEFORE any table has been downloaded.

DisplayName.description: Language name written IN THAT LANGUAGE ("Русский", "Deutsch") — an endonym, not a translation: the picker is read by someone who may not know the current language. Localizing it through the table itself would be circular, so it lives in the config.

IsEnabled.description: When false the language is hidden from the picker and not served, but its table is kept. This is how a language is switched off while it is being translated, without discarding the translator's work.

Locale.description: Canonical locale code — a readability mirror of the dictionary key. It does not affect resolution: the dictionary key is the identifier, as in every other config section.

Order.description: Order in the picker. Ties are broken by locale code.

x-enum-descriptions: Render the key itself. This is the default, and it is what keeps titles whose config holds literal names (rather than keys) working unchanged.
Render the key wrapped in markers (⟦quest.daily.title⟧) — proofreading mode: gaps are visible on screen instead of in a report.
Render an empty string. Appropriate when blank space is preferable to a technical string on top of finished artwork.

value.description: Localization settings of the title. The translation TABLES are not stored here: they live in the separate TitleLocalization collection (one document per title+locale) and are delivered one file per locale. This section only declares which locales exist, which one is the fallback, and the store limits.

DefaultLocale.description: Default locale, which is also the FALLBACK: its table is what the client additionally downloads when its own locale is not fully translated. Stored canonically (lower-case, '-' separator). Empty means "en".

IsEnabled.description: Master switch. When false the server serves neither the manifest nor any table, and the client renders the config strings as-is.

Locales.description: Locales offered to the player, keyed by canonical locale code ("en", "pt-br"). The same code becomes part of the table document _id and of the CDN object key.

MaxEntriesPerLocale.description: Maximum number of entries in a SINGLE locale table. Guards the document against unbounded growth (BSON's 16 MB ceiling) and the importer against an accidentally uploaded foreign file. Recommended: 20000.

MaxValueLengthBytes.description: Length limit of a single translation in bytes (UTF-8). Long-form text (rules, licences) belongs in TitleCustomData, not here. Recommended: 4096.

MissingKeyMode.description: What the client renders when a key is missing from both its own and the fallback table.
